text:
alex: Quick follow-up from the KV eviction postmortem — we need concrete owners and timelines for the testing/evals items so this doesn't fall through the cracks. My proposal: (1) focused regression scenarios, (2) eviction prompt bank + metadata, (3) soak + micro-chaos runbook. Who can pick these up?
priya: I can lead the regression scenarios. Plan: 40 scenario families (prefix overlap, history trimming, rapid prefix switches) with small reproducer harness. Target initial PR in 12 days.
jon: I'll own the eviction prompt bank. Will curate ~250 prompts (short/long prefixes, truncation, tokenized edge cases) and attach expected behaviors + seeds. ETA 9 days.
sara: Ops will run soak + micro-chaos and author the runbook (prechecks, rollback play, metrics to capture). I'll schedule a dry run in staging next week.
alex: Add measurable success criteria per item please — for soak: 30m at 1.2x 99th, 10s synthetic spike; pass if fallback <1%, 95p latency delta <25%, KV miss multiplier <4x.
sara: Acknowledged. We'll add dashboards and a post-run checklist.
priya: For regression, I'll include deterministic seeds and model config tags so CI runs are reproducible. Also will add a lightweight presubmit subset for quick PR feedback.
jon: Prompt bank will include model/quantization variants metadata. Will tag prompts by sensitivity level so we can prioritize gating.
alex: Can we gate PRs touching kv/cache surfaces with a tiny regression subset? That should catch obvious regressions before landing.
priya: Yes — I'll add a presubmit matcher that triggers the small scenario subset. Suggested globs: "src/serving/kv/**", "libs/cache/**", "src/router/**".
sara: Ops-bot, please create tracker issues and add recurrences: weekly regression review (owner: priya) and quarterly chaos execution (owner: sara).
ops-bot: Created tasks: CT-501 (regression scenarios) -> owner: priya, due: 2026-04-20; CT-502 (eviction prompt bank) -> owner: jon, due: 2026-04-14; CT-503 (soak+chaos runbook) -> owner: sara, due: 2026-04-12. Recurrences: weekly regression review (priya), quarterly chaos run (sara). Links: https://tasks.internal/CT-501 https://tasks.internal/CT-502 https://tasks.internal/CT-503
tara: Small ask: include cost/cadence recommendations so the CI matrix doesn't explode. Priya/Jon, can you sample small+med nightly and full sweep weekly?
priya: Yep — small/med for nightly, full matrix weekly. I'll include cost estimates in the PR.
jon: I'll mark high-sensitivity prompts for weekly sweeps, low-sensitivity for nightly.
alex: Also want a short SRE play doc on how to interpret diffs (false positives, flakiness patterns). Tara, can you draft that?
tara: I will. Target draft in 5 days and will attach to CT-501.
sara: Dry run scheduled for Tue 2026-04-07 09:00 PT in staging. Invites sent to owners and ML reviewers.
alex: Thanks all. Summary: priya (regressions) due 2026-04-20, jon (prompt bank) due 2026-04-14, sara (soak+runbook) due 2026-04-12, tara (SRE doc) due 2026-04-08. We'll reconvene after the dry run to lock thresholds and recurrence cadence. :white_check_mark:
